description: This file defines a custom Android View called InteractiveLineGraphView that renders and interacts with a simple interactive line chart of the function x^3 - x/4. It supports gestures such as zooming, panning, double-tap zoom, and flinging, and demonstrates custom rendering, gesture handling, viewport management, and state persistence for a chart component.

classes.name: InteractiveLineGraphView
classes.description: A custom Android View that displays an interactive line chart with zoom and pan functionality, supporting gestures, custom drawing, and state persistence.

classes.name: SavedState
classes.description: A static inner class for saving the view's state, including the current viewport rectangle.

classes.name: AxisStops
classes.description: A helper class representing axis label stops, number of stops, and decimal precision.

methods.name: fun
methods.description: A static method representing the mathematical function y = x^3 - x/4 used for plotting the chart.

methods.name: initPaints
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes Paint objects used for drawing labels, grid lines, axes, and data series based on current attribute values.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size changes, updating content rectangle dimensions.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's dimensions based on suggested constraints and a minimum chart size.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs custom drawing of axes, labels, the data series, and edge effects.

methods.name: drawAxes
methods.description: Draws grid lines, axis labels, and manages axis stops calculation.

methods.name: computeAxisStops
methods.description: Calculates appropriate axis label positions and decimal precision given axis bounds and steps.

methods.name: getDrawX
methods.description: Converts an X chart value to pixel coordinates based on current viewport.

methods.name: getDrawY
methods.description: Converts a Y chart value to pixel coordinates based on current viewport.

methods.name: drawDataSeriesUnclipped
methods.description: Draws the line series for the function y = x^3 - x/4 within the current viewport.

methods.name: drawEdgeEffectsUnclipped
methods.description: Draws overscroll glow effects if applicable.

methods.name: hitTest
methods.description: Determines whether a pixel coordinate falls within the chart and calculates corresponding data point.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Delegates touch events to gesture detectors for handling user interactions.

methods.name: fling
methods.description: Starts a fling animation with specified velocities.

methods.name: computeScrollSurfaceSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the virtual scrollable surface based on zoom level.

methods.name: computeScroll
methods.description: Updates viewport during fling or zoom animations and manages edge effects.

methods.name: setViewportBottomLeft
methods.description: Sets the viewport position with specified bottom-left coordinates, constrained within axis limits.
